caveats: The 48 rows are generated from four hand-authored fraction archetypes; they are not real student interactions.
Generated wording and labels are coupled by construction, so the language baseline can memorize templates.
The persistent-state AUC is below the correctness-only baseline and its ECE is high; it is not calibrated.
These values are for exercising code paths only and must not be reported as empirical research findings.

tier_1_correctness_only_pybkt.name: Tier 1: Correctness-Only KT (pyBKT)
tier_1_correctness_only_pybkt.description: Sequence of question IDs and binary correctness (0/1). Conventional Bayesian Knowledge Tracing.

tier_2_language_aware_baseline.name: Tier 2: Language-Aware Baseline (Direct Text Features)
tier_2_language_aware_baseline.description: TF-IDF text features from student explanation without structured persistence or concept grounding.

tier_3_proposed_persistent_state.name: Tier 3: Structured Evidence + Heuristic Persistent State
tier_3_proposed_persistent_state.description: Language -> Structured Evidence -> KC Grounding -> Hand-tuned mastery and misconception scores; not a trained or calibrated state model.
